answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150276 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it haram or makrooh to drink water that touch moustache? Question: Is it haram or makrooh to drink water that touch moustache? Answer ID: 150276 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 733/705/SD=8/1438) Neither it is haram nor makrooh to drink water which is touched by the moustache. It is baseless belief. However, it is makrooh to grow the moustache beyond the edge of the upper lip. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
